featured.sourceName: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck
featured.title: 嘉宾 Emily Sands（Stripe 数据与 AI 负责人）
featured.summaryEn: Agentic commerce has moved from hypothesis to deployed infrastructure over the past 12 months. Stripe now ships a full stack—the Shared Payment Token (a new payment primitive encoding exactly what an agent may spend, where, and for how long, without exposing card credentials), the Link wallet as a consumer-facing agent wallet with granular guardrails, and the ACP protocol (co-built with OpenAI, "MCP for commerce") that lets merchants expose catalogs once to all compatible agents. Emily Sands, Stripe's head of data and AI, frames agentic commerce as a spectrum: from fully autonomous machine-to-machine payments (Stripe's MPP) to humans searching inside AI surfaces where answers now come with a buy button. Consumers mostly hover at "level two"—leaning on AI for discovery but still choosing the item, concentrated in low-to-mid priced goods. Partners already span Google (AI mode/Gemini), Mic…
featured.insightZh: Agentic commerce（AI 代理买卖）过去一年从"假设"走到"真基建"，Stripe 已把共享支付令牌（Shared Payment Token）、Link 代理钱包、ACP 协议铺开；而真正被严重低估的新型欺诈是"token 盗窃"——AI 时代不用偷钱偷卡，直接偷 token 就够了。 过去 12 个月里，AI 代理购物从"纯理论"变成了跑着真实交易量的基础设施。Emily Sands 把 agentic commerce 拆成一条谱系：一端是完全自主的机器对机器支付（Stripe 的 MPP 协议），另一端是人在 AI 界面里搜索、AI 给答案并附带"购买按钮"。现实中消费者大多停留在 L2——让 AI 帮忙找商品、代理帮忙跳过繁琐结账流程，但最终决策还是自己拍板，且集中在中低价商品。Stripe 已和 Google（AI mode / Gemini）、微软 / OpenAI（Copilot / ChatGPT）、Meta（广告内结账）打通，供给侧接入了 Best Buy、Coach、Kate Spade 等品牌和 Shopify、Wix、BigCommerce 等平台。 技术底座是两块：一是 ACP（Agentic Commerce Protocol，与 OpenAI 共建，类比"商务领域的 MCP"），让商家把商品目录、库存、价格暴露一次即可对接所有兼容代理；二是 Shared Payment Token——一个全新支付原语，把"代理能向哪些商家、扣多少、什么币种、多久有效"编码进令牌，代理全程看不到真实卡号，且平台 / 支付处理器无关（可传给 Adyen 等）。Link 钱包（已有 3 亿消费者）则是面向消费者的代理钱包，可设预算、按域限制、逐笔审批、随时撤回。 最值得企业级读者警惕的是 token 盗窃——Emily 称之为"AI 领域最被低估的话题，可能被低估很多"。SaaS 时代边际成本近零，被薅一点羊毛无所谓；但 AI 每次推理都有真实成本，欺诈率一高，产品经济模型会迅速崩掉。Stripe 观察到三种主流模式：①多账号滥用——AI 公司…
